text: `critic-prose` loads the `IN-PR-*` base plus the declared discipline's rules, parameterised by language (author or content, resolved from config `languages`); its `agent.md` cites the `IN-PR-STYLE-004` mechanical pass and preserves the two-form detrope (mechanical default + `IN-AU-CRAFT-003` `/in-detrope` handoff, never invoked).
